coins_latest.description: October is Blindness Awareness Month, yet no memecoin has stepped up to carry the cause and bring real attention to it. Until now. Introducing $Ape 100% of the creator fees I receive will be donated to VISIONS/Services for the Blind and Visually Impaired to help support people living with blindness and vision loss. It's time to go BLIND APE for people who are losing their sight. Millions of people around the world struggle with vision loss every single day, and many don't have access to the resources or support they need. I believe the memecoin community has an opportunity to come together and actually make a difference while spreading awareness for an important cause. I have over 1 MILLION followers across all platforms, and I'll be using my entire audience to bring as much attention to this movement as possible. My goal is to introduce thousands of new people to $Ape while showing them how our community can come together to support something bigger than just another memecoin. I'm also going to be reaching out to VISIONS directly with the goal of onboarding the charity into the memecoin space. I want them to see what we're building and how creator fees can be used to generate real donations while bringing awareness to their organization. I'll be LIVE on Pumpfun working alongside the community, spreading awareness, and using my platform to get this cause in front of as many people as possible. Imagine an entire community of trenchers and degenerates coming together to support people who are blind or visually impaired. A community that usually comes together to send coins to millions now coming together to help people who genuinely need it. This is bigger than just another memecoin. This is an opportunity to show everyone what the trenches are capable of when we unite behind a meaningful cause. Let's make $Ape the face of Blindness Awareness Month and turn this into something that actually makes a difference.
